summary: Reserve bounded residency metric instruments without activating producers

replay.detail: No claim writers, replay or projection changes.

compatibility.detail: Nine inert instruments have a closed 40-series vocabulary. The HTTP duration SDK limit decreases from 1500 to 1460, reserving rather than adding residency headroom. No daemon constructs the instruments yet.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or interruption expected; no producer is enabled.

manual.detail: No configuration or operator actions required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; rollback restores the previous HTTP limit.
